Import health data from an external source into the local database.

Usage:
  healthcli import [command]

Available Commands:
  apple       Import an Apple Health export

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for import

Global Flags:
      --db string   SQLite database path (default: per-user data dir)
      --json        output JSON instead of human-readable text

Use "healthcli import [command] --help" for more information about a command.
